brief:
Mondoweiss reported that American backing for Israel transformed fundamentally between the 1950s and the present day. In the first episode of "The Necessary State," analyst Sana Saeed examines how U.S. policy shifted from a cautious, transactional approach in the 1950s toward the current stance that treats support for Israel as politically untouchable across the American political spectrum.

The analysis traces the mechanisms and turning points that solidified what had once been conditional support into an unquestioned consensus within U.S. foreign policy.
dek: In Episode 1 of The Necessary State, Sana Saeed traces how American support for Israel went from cautious and transactional in the 1950s to the untouchable consensus it is today.
title: U.S. support for Israel evolved from cautious to unconditional over decades
